resources.string: This app is the current Home app
Running as a normal app (Google TV is still Home)
Home button still opens Google TV. Turn on \"Home Test redirect\" in Settings → Accessibility.

Opens your Home Test screen when you turn on the TV and whenever Google TV\'s home screen appears, such as when you press Home. It only receives events from Google TV\'s home screen and cannot read what is on screen.
Home role is not available on this device
